subject: Privilege evidence: SCIM + SAML samples and role-activation logs
messages:
From: Anna Roberts <anna.roberts@crescentfin.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: security@crescentfin.com
Date: 2026-11-20T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Request: IAM evidence for SOC 2 - privilege justification

Hi Priya,

We're preparing materials for our SOC 2 vendor review and need a focused access/IAM packet from Redwood covering SSO/SAML, SCIM provisioning, and your RBAC/least-privilege controls. Specifically we'd like: 

- SSO configuration screenshots (IdP metadata and ACS URLs) and at least two example SAML assertions that show the standard attributes you pass (name, email, groups/roles).
- SCIM provisioning delta for October 2026 (creates/updates/deletes) and a short note on how you handle group-to-role mapping.
- Current RBAC role matrix (what permissions map to which roles) and any justifications for roles that have elevated privileges.

Deadline: can you confirm if you can deliver a minimally redacted evidence bundle by COB Friday, Nov 27? Our compliance team said redaction is fine for PII but they need raw assertion examples and the SCIM csv.

Thanks — happy to hop on a short 20-min call if helpful.

Anna
Anna Roberts
Lead InfoSec Analyst
Crescent Financial

Attachments requested: saml example, scim delta, role matrix
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Anna Roberts <anna.roberts@crescentfin.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-20T11:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: IAM evidence for SOC 2 - privilege justification

Hi Anna — thanks for the clear list. We can put together a scoped evidence bundle. Two quick clarifications before we assemble: 

1) For SAML assertions: do you need both a production and staging example, or will a single production-like sample with redacted PII suffice?
2) For SCIM delta: do you only need the adds/updates/deletes for October, or would a sampling (first/last week) be acceptable if you have sensitivity concerns?

Plan: Marcus will pull the SCIM delta export and sample SAML assertions; Naomi will assemble the RBAC matrix and provide short role justification notes. We'll produce: (A) scim-delta-oct2026.csv (CSV stub, full timestamps), (B) saml-assertion-examples.txt (two assertion samples with attributes redacted as needed), (C) least-privilege-role-matrix.pdf (role list + justification). We'll flag anything that has customer PII so your team can confirm redaction scope.

I expect a draft bundle by Tue Nov 24 EOD; final by Nov 27 if nothing blocks. If you need it sooner we'll prioritize the SAML samples first.

Best,

Priya Natarajan
Compliance Manager, Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwood.com
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>

Date: 2026-11-22T08:27:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Request: IAM evidence for SOC 2 - privilege justification

Hi all — attaching the initial SCIM delta and a couple of SAML assertion examples (see attachment stubs below). Notes: 

- scim-delta-oct2026.csv (attachment stub): contains timestamped operations (CREATE/UPDATE/DELETE), user urns, externalIds, and the group membership changes we push. I filtered out raw emails when present; if you need the full column we can provide it under an NDA/secure transfer.
- saml-assertion-examples.txt (attachment stub): two assertions taken from successful logins (subject and email redacted); attributes included: uid, name, mail, groups. We include the group-to-role mapping we apply on the service side in-line.

A couple of operational clarifications in case Crescent needs them for evidence narratives: 
- Group-to-role mapping: we map SCIM groups to internal RBAC roles during provisioning; role activation for privilege elevation is audited and logged (see role-activation-logs request below).
- Delegated admin exceptions: we have a small set (<1% of enterprise tenants) that use delegated admin. Those exceptions are tracked via change requests and approved by our Security Ops team — Naomi can drop the approval trail in the packet if required.

Attachments (delivered as stubs in this thread): scim-delta-oct2026.csv, saml-assertion-examples.txt

Thanks Marcus — got the stubs and the notes, much appreciated. A couple of follow-ups from our compliance reviewers: 

- Can you include role-activation-logs for Nov 1–15 (we need to see timestamped role grants/activations and the audit fields showing who initiated/approved)? CSV is ideal.
- For SAML assertions: one production-like sample is fine; staging not required. Please keep subject/email redacted but include the full attributes list and the raw NameID/issuer/ACS metadata lines.
- For the SCIM csv: if you can provide the full columns but obfuscate internal email addresses, that should be acceptable.

If you can push the role-activation-logs by tomorrow morning Nov 24 we can keep our review on track. We can accept redaction; please flag any rows you believe require a separate secure transfer.

Happy to take a short call at 10am PST tomorrow if that helps.

Best,
Anna
